title: 2027 Volkswagen Jetta GLI Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Volkswagen Jetta GLI is a carryover model, following a refresh for the 2025 model year. It remains a good value rival to cars such as the Honda Civic Si and the Hyundai Elantra N.
body_markdown:
While the daily commute may suggest dealers only offer SUVs and pickup trucks, the compact sedan segment is alive and well represented by models such as the Volkswagen Jetta GLI. Like all Jettas, the GLI balances affordability with efficiency and practicality, but with an extra dose of attitude. Rivals include the Honda Civic Si and VW's own Golf GTI, though the GLI is also cross-shopped with the Subaru WRX and the Hyundai Elantra N.

## What’s New for the 2027 Volkswagen Jetta GLI


Volkswagen last updated all Jetta variants, including the GLI, for the 2025 model year. That refreshed model carries over into 2027 as a front-wheel-drive (FWD) four-door, five-passenger sedan available in a single Autobahn trim. Compared with other Jettas, the GLI adds styling enhancements, more power, bigger brakes, and a responsive multi-link rear suspension.


## Design


To the casual observer, the GLI Autobahn may appear to be just another Jetta sedan, with sleek front and rear LED lighting, stylish creases along the flanks, and alloy wheels. But look a little closer and there are unique bumpers with red accents up front, dual exhaust tips out back, standard 18-inch two-tone alloy wheels, red brake calipers, and a power panoramic sunroof. An optional GLI Black Package swaps in a set of 18-inch black alloys and black mirror caps, and two-tone paint with a Deep Black roof.


## Powertrain


Under the hood of every 2027 VW Jetta GLI is a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine that pumps out 228 horsepower and 258 pound-feet of torque. That's mated to a seven-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic transmission with paddle shifters. As is increasingly common, even among sporty models, it doesn't offer a manual transmission. According to the EPA, drivers can expect to see 26 mpg in the city, 35 mpg on the highway, and 29 mpg combined. Supporting the powertrain is an adaptive suspension with selectable drive modes, VW's XDS Cross Differential System, and a limited-slip front differential. Collectively, they create the best-handling Jetta available.


## Interior


Befitting its sporty character, the GLI Autobahn's interior includes a flat-bottomed, leather-wrapped, tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel with paddle shifters, as well as stainless steel foot pedal caps, red accents, and illuminated scuff plates. The five-passenger GLI also features perforated leather upholstery, a power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, heated and ventilated front bucket seats, color-adjustable ambient lighting, and dual-zone automatic climate control. A 60/40 split-folding rear seat includes a center armrest and accommodates up to three people, but can be folded down to expand the 14.1-cubic-foot trunk.


## Technology


For those familiar with everything Jetta, the GLI Autobahn's technology features largely mirror those of the SEL, which is the most expensive non-GLI trim level. Among the standard items are an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system with VW Premium Sound, a SiriusXM satellite radio trial subscription, voice control, Wi-Fi capability, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, and wireless charging. The 2027 GLI Autobahn also comes with a 10.25-inch customizable digital gauge display and dual-zone automatic climate control.

## Safety


Volkswagen's IQ.Drive driver-assistance technology bundle is standard on the 2027 GLI, and features a semi-automated driving function, forward-collision warning, emergency braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, and a semi-automated emergency assistance feature that kicks in if the driver becomes unresponsive. Every Jetta GLI also comes with a rearview camera and high-beam assist. Neither the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) nor the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) differentiates between the Jetta and the Jetta GLI models. In NHTSA testing, this FWD sedan earned an overall five-star rating. The IIHS had not published results for the 2027 Jetta at the time of writing, but the virtually identical 2026 model scored Good in the small overlap front test and Acceptable for its performance in the updated side-impact test.


## Pricing and Release Date


At the time of writing, the 2027 Volkswagen Jetta GLI Autobahn was on sale for $33,795 plus a $1,325 destination charge. A GLI Black Package is available for $650 and adds 18-inch black alloy wheels, black mirror caps, and a Deep Black roof. Extra-cost paint colors include Kings Red Metallic and Monument Gray, both available with or without the Deep Black roof. No other significant option packages are available, though buyers can choose from a wide variety of accessories, such as an auto-dimming rearview mirror with Homelink ($405) or rubber floor mats ($190).
